gh_03_intro.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh_03_intro.text: Kurogane parked their new prototype in the lot off Third. Unguarded, apparently. Crack the lock and bring it to the chop shop, and keep the paintwork in one piece, yeah?

gh_03_alarm.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh_03_alarm.text: That's the alarm. Patrols are on you and Kurogane will send muscle. Three minutes, then the buyer walks.

gh_03_done.speaker: VESPER · GLASSHOUNDS
gh_03_done.text: Lovely bit of chrome. Credits are on your chip.
